svg.text: Architecture v2 - Cloudflare Tunnel + Zero Trust (current)
The tunnel inverts the connection: one container dials out, all ingress rides back through it. Nothing listens on the WAN.
CLOUDFLARE EDGE - ANYCAST DNS · TLS · DDOS ABSORPTION · DNSSEC
email OTP - gates ssh.* before any bytes flow
public DNS points at Cloudflare’s anycast edge -
the home IP appears in no DNS record, anywhere
HOME NETWORK - ZERO OPEN PORTS · ZERO PORT FORWARDS
RASPBERRY PI 5 · UBUNTU SERVER · DOCKER COMPOSE
HTTPS - TLS terminates at the edge
attack surface: a Cloudflare account + an email account (both hardware-2FA’d) - not ports, not IPs
HOME NETWORK - ZERO OPEN PORTS · ZERO PORT FORWARDS
RASPBERRY PI 5 · UBUNTU SERVER · DOCKER COMPOSE
